initialization: Fresh owned MATLAB; select and retain gpuDevice once; wait before baseline; load exact modules and retain declared fixture inputs; no device reset or cache flushing
sample_boundary: Operation returned, temporary caller outputs released, all owned handles destroyed, wait on retained device; sample before writing progress/results
sampling_route: One MATLAB loop per 100-run series. In-process Windows System.Diagnostics.Process.PrivateMemorySize64 and WorkingSet64 after Refresh; no Engine calls between operations. Preallocate sample buffers and warm the sampler five times before the five operation warmups. Durable progress is written after each sampled group of ten.
observer_controls: Preserve v1 external-Engine sampling failures and no-operation counterfactuals. Both showed approximately 50 MiB process excursions without gateway work. Test in-process observer-only control before attributing a retaining owner. MATLAB memory() is not called during a series. No limit, warmup count, iteration count or numerical gate is relaxed.
owner_investigation: Separate CSR-only, IC-only and validation-harness/file-IO controls when retention is positive; do not label an opaque allocator or cache without evidence
interpretation: Passing limits is not proof of zero leaks or exact global peak. Preserve all initial/cold and failed records. No Field-specific initialization, threshold, warmup or sampling exception. CPU and true-residual gates remain separate and unchanged.
